title: tormentilla humifusa
intro: Tormentilla humifusa, commonly known as yellow cress, is a perennial plant native to the mountainous regions of Europe. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and enhancing immune function. The therapeutic actions of Tormentilla humifusa are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit anti-inflammatory properties, and act as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycosides, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
